'''Barin Madwen''' was the [[innkeeper]] at the [[The Nine Rings (inn)]] in [[Tremonsien]]. He was married to [[Maglin Madwen]] from Lugard for 23 years.

==Activities==
When he died he left the inn to his wife and his money to his brother.{{ref/book|2|21}}
